#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/brittonr/sbfp-20261113-berdKH/qualification-publication-787784fb.CmcH2N
test ! -e validation-preparation-publication.log
exec > validation-preparation-publication.log 2>&1
finished=0
trap 'status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$finished" -ne 1 ]; then status=1; fi; printf "validation_exit=%s\n" "$status"; exit "$status"' EXIT
set -x
date -Is
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=url.https://github.com/.insteadOf GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=ssh://git@github.com/ GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
/run/current-system/sw/bin/nix develop --offline --builders "" --no-write-lock-file -c cairn validate --root .
date -Is
finished=1
printf "validation_complete=1\n"
scope: Completed source-only preparation and transport evidence; excludes live graph-review/identity-review directories. No review acceptance or proof launch.
